images.description: Ordered local /images/ references or PNG/JPEG/WebP base64 data URLs

source.description: PNG, JPEG or WebP base64 data URL

extraParams.description: Additional protocol parameters; bound fields and credentials cannot be overridden.

channelId.description: Stable saved channel reference. Latest saved model, endpoint, protocol, parameters and credential binding are resolved before each request; missing channel fails without snapshot fallback.

config.description: Cloud ProviderConfig or {provider:comfyui,baseUrl,outputNodeId}. Stored/environment credentials only.

frameIndex.description: Original zero-based storyboard index, including subset jobs.

workflow.description: ComfyUI API graph; mio-image://N strings are replaced with uploaded image filenames.

owner.description: Opaque integration correlation ID; not a user permission boundary.

cursor.description: Confirmed result count, NOT a contiguous prefix or next frame index.

errors.description: Last 30 attempt errors; detail endpoint only

editableFrames.description: Unfinished resolved cloud prompts; modify only through the audited amend operation.

currentChannels.description: Safe server-saved configuration preview for subsequent requests; not the model of an already-running attempt.

requestHistory.description: Latest 100 prepared attempt inputs: local index, attempt, timestamp, hash, prompt, negative, images, config and frame parameters. Not proof the upstream accepted a request.

frameStates.description: Independent states by task-local frame index, including skipped (HTTP 422), sparse completion, attempt counts, retry deadlines and upstream IDs.

mode.description: Failure behavior within one task; never pauses other manually started tasks.

concurrency.description: Independent in-flight frame limit PER TASK. Default tasks run FIFO; explicit start adds another pool.

acknowledgeUnconfirmed.description: Must be true for unknown results; caller accepts possible duplicate billing for this frame.
